Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a hyperechoic, cystic mass in the fetal thorax (indicated by arrows) with significant systemic arterial supply on Doppler, characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration or hybrid lesion. Such space-occupying lesions in the right lung typically cause mass effect, displacing the heart to the contralateral (left) side and pushing the diaphragm downward or elevating it due to compression, matching the description in option B.
